on 20 March, 2024
 The Honourable Smt. Justice K. Sujana
 Criminal Petition No.2969 of 2024
Order:

This criminal petition is filed under Section 482 Cr.P.C to quash the proceedings against the petitioner/accused No.1 in C.C.No.295 of 2007, on the file of learned Judicial Magistrate of First Class, Shadnagar, Ranga Reddy District previously Mahabubnagar District.

entities.text: Judicial Magistrate of First Class, Shadnagar, Ranga Reddy District
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. Heard Sri Sankalp Pissay, learned counsel for the petitioner and Sri S. Ganesh, learned Assistant Public Prosecutor for respondent No.1-State.
Perused the record.

3. The Food Inspector, S.S.Gutta, Mahabubnagar filed a complaint before the learned Magistrate against the petitioner herein and another for the offences punishable under Sections 16(1)(a) (1)
read with Section 2(ia)(b) and Section 7(i) of the Prevention of Food and Adulteration Act, 1954 against the petitioner/accused No.1.
4.

entities.text: Prevention of Food and Adulteration Act, 1954
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The allegations in the complaint, in brief, are that on 28.01.2006, the Food Inspector visited the shop of accused No.1 and found 2000 packets (each containing 50 gms of Agni brand tea dust manufactured by M/s Tata Tea Limited) in carton boxes along with other food items.
The Food Inspector drew samples as per the procedure prescribed and sent the same to the Public Analyst for analysis.
The Public Analyst in his report opined that the sample contains 172 ppm of iron filings which is against the prescribed stands and is thus adulterated.
Later, the Food Inspector filed complaint before the learned Magistrate against the accused Nos.1 to 3 alleging offences as stated above.
5. Accused Nos.2 and 3 filed Crl.M.P.No.2724 of 2010 before the learned Magistrate under Section 245 Cr.P.C seeking to discharge him from the offences registered against them.
The learned Magistrate vide order dated 09.06.2011 dismissed the said petition.

Aggrieved thereby, the accused N o s . 2 a n d 3 f i l e d C r l . R . P . N o . 6 6 o f 2 0 1 1 b e f o r e t h e l e a r n e d J u d g e , F a m i l y Court-cum-VIII-Additional District and Sessions Judge, Mahabubnagar.
The learned Additional District and Sessions Judge vide judgment dated 19.07.2013 dismissed the revision petition and confirmed the order passed by the learned Magistrate.

6. The learned Assistant Public Prosecutor submits that as per the orders dated 02.11.2017 issued by the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India, the Commissioners of Food Safety of all the States were directed not to launch for non-conformance of limit of iron filings for cases where samples were picked up/tested prior to 19.05.2016 and were advised to withdraw all such prosecutions launched prior to 19.05.2016 either under FSS Act, 2006 or PFA Act, 1954.

entities.text: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: In view of the above, she submits that the prosecution of petitioner/accused No.1 in the present case would not survive and prays for passing appropriate orders.

sentences.text: Keeping in view the orders dated 02.11.2017 and letter dated 20.06.2022 addressed by the Food Safety Officer, Mahabubanagar to the learned Public Prosecutor to withdraw all prosecutions launched prior to 19.05.2016 either under the FSS Act or PFA Act, the prosecution of petitioner/accused No.1 does not survive and is not maintainable.
8. In view of the above, the criminal petition is allowed.

Consequently, the proceedings against the petitioner/accused No.1 in C.C.No.295 of 2007, on the file of the learned Judicial Magistrate of First Class, Shadnagar, Ranga Reddy District previously Mahabubnagar District, are hereby quashed.

opennyai_summary.decision:
In view of the above, she submits that the prosecution of petitioner/accused No.1 in the present case would not survive and prays for passing appropriate orders.
Keeping in view the orders dated 02.11.2017 and letter dated 20.06.2022 addressed by the Food Safety Officer, Mahabubanagar to the learned Public Prosecutor to withdraw all prosecutions launched prior to 19.05.2016 either under the FSS Act or PFA Act, the prosecution of petitioner/accused No.1 does not survive and is not maintainable.
8. In view of the above, the criminal petition is allowed.

Pending miscellaneous petitions, if any, in this Criminal Petition shall also stand closed.
